description: This file defines a React-like component using Qwik framework for a note editor with create, view, update, and delete functionalities. It manages local state, loads notes, handles user interactions, and communicates with external API functions.

methods.name: loadNote$
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a note by ID from external API and updates component state.

methods.name: save$
methods.description: Saves the current note, either creating a new one or updating an existing one, via external API.

methods.name: remove$
methods.description: Deletes the current note after user confirmation via external API.
